tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: khyung gi sgrub thabs zab mo bzhugs so:

bka' brgyad rang shar las so// khyung chen yongs rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 1$0000250sgrub chen bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi bka' sdod: rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs bskul bar 'dod pas: mchod rdzas bsham zhing khyad par du gtor ma la nya sbal sbrul shas brgyan pa bsham: 1$0000300rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du: hūm̐ raṃ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus: khroṃ las rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs ni: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing nag rngam pa'i sku: rdo rje'i rwa gdengs gnam lcags mchu sder can: gser mig gshog sgro ral gri spu gris gtams: phyag gnyis sbrul rigs nag po zhal du 'dren: sprul pa yang sprul grangs med phyogs bcur 'phro: kun kyang 'gro don mdzad phyir las la chas: sprin phung lta bur gtibs shing mchu sder bgrad: sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad bsgral zhing gsol: khroṃ: phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs snyan gson cig: sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir spyan 'dren gyis: rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: khroṃ badz+ra gha ru ḍaḥs ma ya dzaḥdza: khroṃ: rab 'jigs drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas 'dir: sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir: rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas rnams: gnyis med brtan par bzhugs la 'phrin las mdzod: sa ma ya ā be sha ya a ā: khroṃ: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar pa yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta bha ling rgyan: sa bdag klu gnyan sha khrag rus la sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pū tsa khā hi: khroṃ badz+ra gha ru ḍaḥhūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra ga ru ṇa tsa le nā ga mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa:1$0000250 bsnyen pa'o: de nas sgrub pa'i sngags ni:

1$0000300oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bhun+dhe bhe ra yā: tad+ya thā: spu ta spu ta: bhe ra bhe ra: mi li mi li: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: oṃ nā ga li duṃ pa ya: pa stoṃ pa stoṃ: ti ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥbh+yo bh+yo:1$0000250 de nas las sbyor sngags ni: 1$0000300oṃ ghu ro bho ha ya dza: e mā ra ya dza: nā ga mā ra ya sod: nā ga mā ra ya bying: nā ga mā ra ya rmugs: nā ga mā ra ya myogs: nā ga mā ra ya du: nā ga mā ra ya bying: thuṃ ril dza: badz+ra gha ru ḍaḥya dza:1$0000250 ces bzlas na klu thams cad kyi snying dus gcig la 'byin nges so: don med par klu gzir na sdig che'o: thabs gzhan gyis ma phan na 'di bsgrub bo: zhag nyer gcig gis tsho 'o: 'di ni me dang 'dra 'o: sa bdag klu gnyan gsod par 'gyur ro: sngags 'di ni bzla mi dgos te: blo la yod pas kyang klu thams cad skrag pa yin no: klu la za res 'beb pa'i las so: de nas skabs su gtor ma 'bul zhing bstod bskul bya'o: 1$0000300nā ga sha trūṃ khā hi: hūm̐ khroṃ: ri rab rtse la gnas pa yi: rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs ni: sku mdog sna tshogs 'od zer 'bar: rang bzhin khyung ni mkha' ltar khyab: ye shes khyung ni sprin ltar gtibs: sprul pa'i khyung ni char ltar 'beb: yang sprul khyung ni thog ltar 'phro: khyung gshog 'bar bas bar snang khengs: khyung ru mi mngon dbyings su gsigs: sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas 'dul: sder mos klu gnyan sa bdag 'dren: zhal nas me 'bar klu gnyan sreg: shangs nas dud 'thul 'byung po brgyal: spyan mig bgrad nas klu gnyan sdigs: ljags kyi rkan sgras klu gnyan skrag: gsung gi nga ros klu gnyan 'dar: stobs chen rgyal po khyung gi tshogs: sprul pa yang sprul grangs med 'phro: klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul la brtson: zas su klu gnyan sha la za: skom du klu gnyan khrag la 'thung: khyed rnams khros shing gsigs pa'i tshe:

sprul pa grangs med phyogs bcur 'gyed: klu gnyan sa bdag rdul du rlog: dgra bgegs steng du bab pa'i tshe: la la lding zhing la la 'phur: 'phur ba'i gshog sgra 'u ru ru: sgrol ba'i rngams sgra di ri ri: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder gyis: sa bdag klu gnyan snying rtsa drongs: gnod byed thams cad zas su zo: khro chung 'bar ba'i spyan mig gis: nad gdon ltems se bzhu nas gsol: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rwa gdengs nas: bskal pa'i me 'bar 'ur sgra 'byin: steng gi lha srin gdug pa sgrol: spyi gtsug yid bzhin nor bus brgyan: sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: gnod byed klu gnyan sa bdag 'di: dbang du sdus la myur du sgrol: rings par khug la zas su gsol: srog gcod snying phyungs sha rus gtubs: rngams zas khyur mid hab sha rol: phyo phyo klu gnyan snying rtsar phyo: bdag la gnod pa'i klu gnyan la: gshog sgra can gyis snying nas phyungs: sder mo can gyis snying nas drongs: rkan sgra can gyis zhal du gsol: rdul phran tsam yang med par rol: dus la bab po sa ma ya: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di 'bul gyis: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs la: bdag ni rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal: khyed kyi thugs rjes klu gnyan sgrol: dam las ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: nā ga sod nā ga gtubs: nā ga mā ra ya rbad rbad:1$0000250 ces bskul lo: 'di la yi dam byas na klu la za res 'beb nges so: 1$0000300mdze 'joms klu 'dul rgyud las: khol du o rgyan pad+mas phyung ba 'o: klu sa bdag nye mi nus so: thabs gzhan rdugs na 'di bya'o: khyung gi sgrub thabs zab mo rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zang zang lha brag nas spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000250༄༅: khyung chen yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bzhugs so: 1$0000300rgyal sras khyung gi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: khyung chen rigs lnga'i dbang lnga ni:

bum chu dbu rgyan rdo rje dang: dril bu ming gi dbang bskur bya: rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: bsnyen pa'i dbang bskur thob pa yis: sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar: dkyil 'khor rgyan ldan dam rdzas bsham: bsnyen sgrub rtags rnams rab rdzogs nas: slob ma khrus byas bgegs bskrad bya: maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab: ho: yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso: ye shes khyung chen zil gnon gyi: byin rlabs dbang bskur tshul bzhin du: bdag la bstsal bar mdzad du gsol: dpon slob gnyis ka khyung du bsgom: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes me tog dor: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis dkyil 'khor bstan: khyung chen lnga yi phyag rgya yis: gnas lngar gtug cing dam chur gyur: sa ma ya yi dam tshig bsgrag: oṃ bhud+dha: badz+ra: rat+na: pad+ma: karma: sa ma ya a ā: de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste: hūm̐: bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang: khyung chen rigs lngas byin brlabs pa: sdug bsngal thams cad sel byed pa'i: ye shes bum chus dbang bskur ro: oṃ bhud+dha ga ru ḍaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: oṃ rat+na ga ru ḍaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ: oṃ pad+ma ga ru ḍaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca hrī: oṃ karma ga ru ḍaḥ.a bhi ṣiñca ā: dbu rgyan gtad de: hūm̐: dbu rgyan rigs lngas dbang bskur bas: bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub byed pa'i: khyung chen rigs lnga'i dbang yin te: sdug bsngal sel bar dbang bskur ro: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: rdo rje gtad de: rdo rje thabs mchog dbang bskur bas: mtshan ma'i rnam rtog kun 'joms pa: chags pa dag dang bral bar byed: khyung chen dbang ni bskur bar bya: oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: dril bu gtad de: shes rab dril bus dbang bskur bas: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub byed pa'i: dngos grub thams cad thob byed pa: khyung chen dbang ni bskur bar bya: oṃ karma shab+da a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: khyung sku'i dbang: hūm̐:

rgyal sras mtshan mas dbang bskur bas: the tshom rtog pa spangs pa ste: nyon mongs thams cad 'dul ba'i gtso: khyung chen dbang ni bskur bar bya: oṃ bhud+dha nām a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: ho: khyung chen rnams kyi dbang bskur bas: klu dang gnod sbyin dri za dang: sa bdag gnyan dang 'byung po dang: bdug pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs 'gyur: oṃ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: khams gsum sems can thams cad la: dbang bskur gdug pa'i nad las grol: khyung chen dbang 'di rab tu skur: ces bskur ro: rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar bya'o: rgyal sras khyung chen yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ma 'ongs gdug pa 'dul don du: zang zang lha brag rked la sbas: smug nag khros pa khro bo'i rigs: rgod kyi ldem 'phru can dang sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zang zang lha brag nas rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis bton pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
